as_told.title: Walter B. Smith memo on using UFO phenomena against Soviets

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a letter from Walter B. Smith, then head of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, dated around 1953. Michels says it suggested using the UFO phenomenon as psychological warfare against the Soviet Union, and that similar leaked letters exist from Allen Dulles, who later led the CIA. In another telling he is less sure of the date and calls it a memo, but either way he offers it as a sign the government took the subject seriously early on.
